_note: Sections anchored to IPTC Media Topics and Suspilne's desks, plus the owner's rulings on contested posts (2026-09-22): the subject decides, not the speaker; business adapting to the war is economy; peace talks stay in politics as their own tag.

war.what: armed conflict and its direct physical results (IPTC conflict, war and peace): an attack or strike on a specific place and its consequences — casualties, destruction, fires, fallen debris even without damage; fighting and the front line; the armed forces, weapons and military technology, foreign included; mobilization and military service; prisoners of war and exchanges; occupation and war crimes; sabotage, enemy agents and collaborators; military exercises and threats by armies
war.not_for: businesses or public services adapting to the war (a company closing during alerts) — economy or other; peace talks — politics; signals without an object, daily counters, attack summaries and unit videos of ordinary targets — not_news
examples: Унаслідок удару по Харкову загинули двоє людей
Уламки дрона впали біля житлового будинку
Турецькі інженери навчили Bayraktar TB2 придушувати радари
У Білорусі розпочалися військові навчання біля кордонів

politics.what: power and government as the subject (IPTC politics and government): elections and parties, parliament and government as institutions, appointments and dismissals, diplomacy, peace talks, sanctions, corruption of officials and anti-corruption bodies, what authorities spend on themselves, other countries' domestic politics including Russia's
politics.not_for: the subject decides, not the speaker: a president or MP talking about the deficit, taxes, prices or energy is economy; a law whose subject is taxes or payments is economy
examples: Рада призначила нового міністра оборони
На облаштування бункера для Верховної Ради заклали 263 млн грн
Російські еліти вивозять родичів за кордон, побоюючись мобілізації

economy.what: money and business (IPTC economy, business and finance; labour): the budget and deficit, taxes and duties and laws on them, prices and tariffs, the hryvnia and banks, a company's decisions in any industry (openings, layoffs, closures, working hours) film and media included, markets and sales, the energy sector and power outages, jobs and wages, social payments and humanitarian cash-aid programmes
economy.not_for: a new gadget or app, and what a technology company builds, launches or opens (a model, a service, a network, a lab) — tech; AI replacing or assisting people at work — tech; a film's or album's release — entertainment
examples: Рада підтримала ПДВ на посилки з AliExpress і Temu
«Нова пошта» не працюватиме під час повітряної тривоги
AMO Pictures скоротила зйомки в Україні
Acted виплачуватиме по 10 800 гривень на людину

incident.what: sudden harm not caused by the war (IPTC disaster, accident and emergency incident; crime, law and justice): crime and police cases, fraud, courts over criminals, a suspect fleeing justice, road accidents, fires, industrial accidents, storms and disasters with damage, poisonings
incident.not_for: consequences of Russian strikes — war; police or sirens with no known event — not_news; corruption of officials — politics
examples: На трасі зіткнулися два авто
У Львові затримали шахраїв
Злива повалила в Одесі 24 дерева

other.what: society (IPTC society, education, health, religion, environment, human interest): transport and public services for residents, education, the healthcare system, religion, language and identity, social issues, human-interest stories, environment
examples: Укрзалізниця призначила додаткові поїзди
МОН змінює правила вступу

tech.what: civilian technology: AI, internet services, telecom, cyber, gadgets and consumer electronics, civilian space and rocket launches; what technology companies build, launch, research or open (a new model, service, mobile network, research lab), AI at work and in public life, tech leaders on where AI is going
tech.not_for: military technology — war; a tech company's layoffs, earnings or prices — economy
examples: OpenAI випустила нову модель
Google відкрила дослідницький центр
Оператор запускає мобільний зв'язок через супутник
Вчені знайшли новий вид

sports.what: matches, results, line-ups, transfers, athletes' and coaches' sporting careers; interviews with athletes and coaches about their sport
examples: Названо стартовий склад Шахтаря на матч Кубка

entertainment.what: culture and lifestyle (IPTC arts, culture, entertainment and media; lifestyle): film, TV, music, games, celebrities and their scandals athletes included, theatre, books, exhibitions, fashion, trends and slang; release dates and premieres
examples: Вийшов трейлер нового фільму
Школярі масово підхопили нову фразу з треку

not_news.what: not a story: ads and promo, including a company's event or contest dressed as news; fundraising; stream and event announcements; a promotional or career-advice interview, an essay or article with no event and no new fact; opinion; greetings; operational: alerts, drone and missile courses, an explosion heard or smoke seen with nothing said about what was hit, air defense working, threats; an unconfirmed signal with no known event (police gathering, sirens); daily counters: N of M shot down, enemy losses per day, a night's attack summary even listing consequences, today's exchange rate, a power-outage schedule published or updated for a day or a region; digests of several stories; unit videos of ordinary targets; minute of silence, farewells
not_news.not_for: an event with consequences or a decision; a one-off report, rating or investigation with new facts — classify by topic; a public figure talking about their field's events (a coach about the Cup, a fighter about a bout, a minister about a decision) — classify by that field; a release date of a film, series or album — entertainment; a fundraiser or programme announced by the state, a company or a large organization — classify by topic
examples: 3х БпЛА курсом на Бровари
